batch: 2026-09-01 USGS Plett Road discharge tables reconciliation 38
method: Computed SHA-256 hashes, byte sizes, row counts and column counts for all three supplied CSV files.
Parsed every row and confirmed that all ten field-measurement records identify station USGS-04121241, parameter 00060, cubic-feet-per-second units and USGS approval status.
Compared each supplied file byte-for-byte with the members of the established USGS 04121241 ZIP package and confirmed three exact archive-member matches.
Preserved the original ZIP as the canonical package while exposing its three exact CSV members as individually searchable and downloadable records.
Linked the three tables to the existing Clam River discharge event and rechecked every open evidence requirement without changing the event date or overstating the dataset.
qualityFindings: The monitoring-location row identifies station 04121241 as CLAM RIVER AT PLETT ROAD AT CADILLAC, MI and site type Stream.
The ten approved discrete discharge observations span June 11, 1975 through September 11, 2001 and range from 6.24 to 57.6 cubic feet per second.
The latest approved observation is 7.43 cubic feet per second on September 11, 2001.
The observations are sparse field visits rather than continuous monitoring, and the tables contain no PFAS results or groundwater-gradient measurements.

queueResolution.reason: No request is closed. The three tables strengthen surface-water hydrology and station-location context, but they do not supply a site-specific potentiometric map, synchronized PFAS transect, groundwater hydraulic tests, receptor chain-of-custody records or leachate-delivery history.
